reason: I already have a smart display that does alarm, weather and calendar, and it cost me less. I've never actually moved my phone out of the bedroom, so I doubt a EUR 120 object would be what changes that.
objection: It does what my Echo or Nest already does, for more money, and it's one more device on the nightstand. The sleep and snoring estimate is the only new thing, and I don't trust a number from room sensing enough to pay for it.
would_change_my_mind: A price near EUR 60 to 70, or proof that it works with my existing smart-home setup instead of sitting beside it.
